subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: What vendor-backed cacheRead/cacheWrite mapping should OpenClaw use for BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao model manifests?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but hard-coding provider pricing needs a maintainer choice because BytePlus/ModelArk exposes cache-hit and cache-storage billing categories that may not map one-to-one to OpenClaw's flat cacheRead/cacheWrite fields.

options.title: Confirm pricing and replace the closed PRs
options.body: Use current vendor pricing to update both manifests and tests in one clean same-repository fix.

options.title: Narrow the work by provider
options.body: Fix BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao separately only if maintainers want staged pricing verification and separate issue tracking.

options.title: Wait for billing proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer can verify cache-hit and storage billing from official docs or a vendor console.

recommendation.title: Confirm pricing and replace the closed PRs
recommendation.body: Use current vendor pricing to update both manifests and tests in one clean same-repository fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider catalog and plugin-manifest history makes this the best available routing owner for the pricing-mapping decision.
